title: Register for an NTN
description: National Tax Number for an individual on IRIS.

questions.prompt: Do you already have an IRIS login?
questions.prompt_ru: Kya IRIS login pehle se hai?

steps.title: Read the registration provision
steps.detail: Section 181 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 is the registration provision for a National Tax Number.
steps.detail_ru: Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 ki section 181 National Tax Number ki registration wali dafa hai.

steps.title: Start the application on IRIS
steps.detail: Use the FBR IRIS portal. This build only links the confirmed IRIS address.
steps.detail_ru: FBR IRIS portal istemal karein. Yeh build sirf confirmed IRIS address ka link dikhati hai.
